card.name: Start of twice and thrice
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "twice" ("tw") or "thrice" ("th", "thr"), usually inside parentheses after a dose or schedule. The word is split so that "ice" comes next.

modes.label: twice after a dose
modes.description: "tw" begins "twice" in a parenthetical such as "(twice the recommended dose" or "(twice per day)".
modes.example: 200 mg daily in single (once per day) or divided (<<tw>>ice per day) doses

modes.label: thrice in schedules
modes.description: "th" or "thr" begins "thrice" or a similar frequency word in a list of dosing schedules.
modes.example: DOT can be achieved with daily, twice weekly or<< thr>>ice weekly regimens

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "tw" word starts and discourages writing out "twice" in full or its Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on the first letters of "twice" or "thrice" when they appear in dosing frequency or multiples of a dose.
